meta.home_desc: Write what you want to leave in {year} and watch it burn in a shared fire, live. 20% of every payment goes to New Year gifts for children in Armenian orphanages.

hero.sub: Write down what you want to leave in {year}. We'll burn it in a shared fire, live, together with thousands of people.
hero.counter: {n} people have already said goodbye to {year}
hero.counter_soon: The fire is lit in December. You can write your paper now.
hero.gift_line: 20% of every paper goes to New Year gifts for children in orphanages

how.title: Three steps into the new year
how.s1_d: One sentence about what you're leaving behind. A bad habit, a fear, a long queue, the exchange rate. Up to 120 characters.
how.s2_d: By card, on the bank's secure page. We never see or store your card details.
how.s3_d: Your paper flies into the fire, burns, and rises to the sky as ash. You get your number and a ready-made story image.

feed.title: What people are leaving behind
feed.sub: Papers appear in the fire without names. If a paper has someone's name, a phone number or a link, we don't show its text.
items: The fear of not making it

options.title: Choose your fire
options.sub: With every option your paper burns in the shared fire and you get your own number.
options.burn_d: Your paper burns in the fire. Your own page and number, plus a story image.
options.burn_wish_d: The old burns, and we keep your wish on gold paper. We'll open it live on 31 December {next}.
options.gift_d: Burn a paper on someone's behalf, with their name. You get a link to send them.
options.midnight_d: Your paper and wish burn in the final minutes of 31 December, in the special midnight stream.

wish.title: Gold paper for {next}
wish.body: Once the old is gone, one thing is left: what you want from the year ahead. Write your wish on gold paper. It doesn't burn. We keep it sealed all year and open it live on 31 December {next}. We'll email you so you can see whether it came true.

gifts.title: From every fire, a gift for a child
gifts.body: We put 20% of every payment towards New Year gifts for children in Armenian orphanages. In January we buy and deliver the gifts and publish every receipt on this site.
gifts.fund_soon: The fund starts with the first payment
gifts.per_paper: {amount} of every {price} paper goes to gifts
gifts.honest: We're a company, not a charity. We make money from this project and we don't hide it. The 20% isn't our business model; it's our decision. New Year is children's favourite holiday, and we want some of the warmth from our fire to reach them.

live.title: Live stream
live.body: From {start} to {end} December the fire burns live, day and night. At midnight on 31 December, a great fire burns every paper of the year.
live.page_sub: Everyone's papers burn here, one after another.
live.waiting: The fire is waiting for new papers
live.stream_soon: The YouTube live stream starts on {start} December.

burn.s1_hint: Don't write real people's names, phone numbers or links. We don't accept papers with insults.
placeholders: The fear of not making it

burn.email_hint_soon: As soon as payments open, we'll send you a link to burn your paper.

burn.soon_d: We're connecting card payments. You can write and save your paper now; as soon as payments open, we'll email you a link to burn it.

gifts_page.title: Where the money goes
gifts_page.lead: Short and honest: how every {price} is split.
gifts_page.split_gift: New Year gifts for children in orphanages
gifts_page.split_company: The company: bank fees, servers, the live stream, taxes and our profit
gifts_page.honest_1: This website is a business. You pay for a service and we make money from it.
gifts_page.honest_2: The 20% isn't a donation from you and isn't a charity collection. It's our own decision to spend part of our income on children's New Year.
gifts_page.honest_3: We don't say "buy to help children". If you burn your paper, burn it because you want to. The children get their share either way.
gifts_page.t1_d: With every payment, 20% is recorded in the gift fund automatically. The total is shown on this page.
gifts_page.t2_d: We'll announce which orphanage or orphanages we're working with.
gifts_page.t3_d: We buy the gifts and deliver them to the children with our blogger friends. We only show children's faces with permission from their parents or guardians.
gifts_page.t4_d: We publish a report: the gifts bought, the receipts and the total amount.
gifts_page.reports_empty: The first report comes in January 2027.

notfound.title: This page has burned
notfound.body: Or it never existed. Come back to the fire.

footer.about: A New Year ritual: write what you're leaving in the old year and watch it burn.
